title: Five Dimensional Points
statementMd:
You are given set of $*n*$ points in 5-dimensional space. The points are labeled from $1$ to $*n*$. No two points coincide.

We will call point $*a*$ *bad* if there are different points $*b*$ and $*c*$, not equal to $*a*$, from the given set such that angle between vectors ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bc6e3d5e5515bb66791ca9a052249e959af2a9a6.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2b2e44b4b49d4da671b9d05dd70bf58772fc6a6.png) is acute (i.e. strictly less than ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png)). Otherwise, the point is called *good*.

The angle between vectors ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/453598e99a6c6151192723fb952c1caf35bfa782.png) in 5-dimensional space is defined as ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73dfa232ec919ce1de408d890c24b9d49969d069.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/707f1153862986f1b7f8d6ea585c4674982e3bab.png) is the scalar product and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ac438acfe8cbf49b733409b450a909ac2b06085.png) is length of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png).

Given the list of points, print the indices of the good points in ascending order.

## Input

The first line of input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$) — the number of points.

The next $*n*$ lines of input contain five integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}, *d*_{*i*}, *e*_{*i*}$ ($|*a*_{*i*}|, |*b*_{*i*}|, |*c*_{*i*}|, |*d*_{*i*}|, |*e*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{3}$)  — the coordinates of the i-th point. All points are distinct.

## Output

First, print a single integer $*k*$ — the number of good points.

Then, print $*k*$ integers, each on their own line — the indices of the good points in ascending order.

## Note

In the first sample, the first point forms exactly a ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png) angle with all other pairs of points, so it is good.

In the second sample, along the cd plane, we can see the points look as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b47e1fa6958eae10e2164a9d9282fdcbcb92a857.png)

We can see that all angles here are acute, so no points are good.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

给定 5 维空间中的 $*n*$ 个点。这些点的编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$，且任意两个点不重合。

如果对于给定点集中的某个点 $*a*$，存在两个不同的点 $*b*$ 和 $*c*$，且它们都不等于 $*a*$，使得向量 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bc6e3d5e5515bb66791ca9a052249e959af2a9a6.png) 与 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2b2e44b4b49d4da671b9d05dd70bf58772fc6a6.png) 的夹角为锐角（即严格小于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png)），则称点 $*a*$ 是*坏点*。否则，称该点为*好点*。

在 5 维空间中，向量 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png) 与 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/453598e99a6c6151192723fb952c1caf35bfa782.png) 的夹角定义为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73dfa232ec919ce1de408d890c24b9d49969d069.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/707f1153862986f1b7f8d6ea585c4674982e3bab.png) 表示它们的点积，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1ac438acfe8cbf49b733409b450a909ac2b06085.png) 表示向量 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8914399eadbd8be3c3196100658870e03c61fee.png) 的长度。

给定这些点，按升序输出所有好点的编号。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3}$）——点的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含五个整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}, *d*_{*i*}, *e*_{*i*}$（$|*a*_{*i*}|, |*b*_{*i*}|, |*c*_{*i*}|, |*d*_{*i*}|, |*e*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{3}$）——第 $i$ 个点的坐标。所有点均不相同。

## 输出格式

首先，输出一个整数 $*k*$——好点的数量。

然后，输出 $*k*$ 个整数，每个整数占一行，表示按升序排列的好点编号。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第一个点与其他任意一对点恰好构成一个 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/362ac8c7a7496dffc06cd0c843287cd822be63c3.png) 角，因此它是一个好点。

在第二个样例中，在 cd 平面上可以看到这些点如下所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b47e1fa6958eae10e2164a9d9282fdcbcb92a857.png)

可以看到，这里的所有角都是锐角，因此没有好点。
